document: FICTIONAL TEST DOCUMENT - not a real contract. Cedar Lantern Equipment Services agrees to provide maintenance to Sample Finch Cafe for two months, from December 1, 2026 through January 31, 2027. The fee is $180 per month, due on the fifth day of each month. The fee includes one preventive maintenance visit per month and telephone support on weekdays from 9 am to 5 pm. Emergency callouts cost an additional $75 plus parts, and require the customer's written approval first. Either side may cancel with 10 calendar days' written notice. Unused prepaid full months will be refunded within 14 days after cancellation. The agreement does not renew automatically after January 31, 2027. The customer retains ownership of all equipment and repair records. Liability is limited to fees paid during the preceding two months, except for deliberate misconduct. All organizations and facts in this document are invented for this test.
situation: I run the fictional cafe. I want to understand the total cost, extra charges, cancellation, refunds, and whether the service renews automatically.
